review_scope: question wording and independence from the prior 30-question set
numeric values, units and applicability conditions
method: Checked the frozen catalog and snapshot identities, matched every source reference to the reviewed ingestion text, and visually checked representative rendered official PDF pages across all three documents. Candidate-system answers were not requested or inspected before this record and the quality gate were frozen.
limitations: AI content review, not a licensed engineering-domain sign-off. The provider-side model revisions are not available. GB 55033-2022 and GB 50157-2013 use the already reviewed OCR artifacts bound to the frozen snapshot.

questions.notes: New DB11 clauses and answer points not used by the prior Phase 1 independent set; checked numbers, inequalities and conditions.
Checked timetable, noise test conditions and auxiliary-power quality limits.
Checked passenger-density, vehicle ventilation, access dimensions, waterproofing, depot access, investigation ratio and concrete strength clauses.
Cross-spec comparisons bind shared predicates only to specifications with direct source evidence and preserve differing applicability conditions.
One ambiguous-scope clarification and two project-fact/measurement insufficiency controls; no fabricated project facts are acceptable.
